Dashboard›Knowledge base›KB-000201

Connect to corporate VPN FR-M17-011 v3

Category: Network & Connectivity · Audience: All employees · Last reviewed 12 May 2026 by Software Lead
Summary

Step-by-step guide to install and connect the corporate VPN client on Windows and macOS, including MFA and common troubleshooting.

Steps
  1. Open the Software Portal and install "PrimeSoft VPN".
  2. Launch the client and sign in with your SSO credentials.
  3. Approve the MFA prompt on your registered device.
  4. Select the nearest gateway and click Connect.
  5. If the connection drops repeatedly, see "Troubleshooting" below or raise a Network ticket.

What's the policy on optional holidays this year?
RM
✨
Per PrimeSoft's Leave Policy FY26 (v2.3):

You are entitled to 2 optional holidays per calendar year, selectable from the published Optional Holiday list for your location.

Rules:
• Must be applied at least 5 working days in advance · or with manager approval for short-notice cases
• Cannot be carried forward to the next year
• Not encashable on separation
• Pro-rated for joiners (joined after 1 Jul → 1 day; after 1 Oct → 0 days)

Bangalore HQ Optional Holiday list for 2026: Pongal · Ramzan · Ganesh Chaturthi · Onam · Eid-e-Milad · Christmas Eve · 26 Jan eve.

→ Apply for optional holiday
📄 Source: Leave Policy FY26 v2.3 · §4.6 Optional Holidays
How do I apply for one?
RM
✨
Here's the step-by-step:

1. Go to Apply › Optional Holiday
2. Choose your holiday from the Bangalore HQ list
3. Pick the calendar date you want to take off (must be ≥ 5 working days away by default)
4. Submit — request routes to Manager One (L1 Manager) for approval
5. SLA: 3 business days. You'll see status in your My leave page.

📄 Source: Help Guide — Apply Optional Holiday (platform v2.4)
How it works: The AI Assistant answers only from your organisation's HR documents uploaded to the Document Centre (M11) and PrimeSoft's platform help guides. If the answer isn't in those sources, it'll say so — it won't guess. All conversations are backend-proxied with PII stripped from prompts; query and response content are not logged (privacy). 🔒 Restricted capability — FR-P03-005. Available only to HR Admin and CEO roles. Implements all 8 Section 5 use cases from the AI Use Cases Prioritisation v1.1 doc.

Governance: RBAC row-level + field-level rules apply at the retrieval layer BEFORE prompt construction. CEO sees the entity; HR Admin sees the entity excluding own record. Sensitive fields (compensation · BGV · perf calibration draft) are NEVER passed to the AI model. For analytics queries (L6, L7), all figures come from M16 aggregates — the LLM composes narrative but does NOT produce numbers. L6 SQL runs in a read-only sandbox with row-level RBAC at the database layer. DPDPA & Legal review required before Phase 1.5 GA for L5, L7, L8.

HR Operations›Project master & UAGs

Project master & User Access Groups FR-M01-014

Managed by HR Admin and Org Admin. Each project belongs to a legal entity; projects, UAGs and tagged employees are scoped within that entity. Within a project, HR Admin or Org Admin creates one or more User Access Groups (UAGs), selects project location(s), and tags employees present in the project. An employee can belong to at most one UAG (globally — across all projects). UAG is an access-control construct only — it governs who can see and act on a population. Leave policies, holiday sets and shifts are not applied via UAG; they are assigned through the Assignment Framework (Org Admin → Assignment rules).

Onboarding Admin›Document clusters

Document clusters FR-M02-002

3 standard clusters · 14 candidates with pending items
Clusters group documents by signing pattern (M11 DM17). Sign-Off cluster: compliance acknowledgements (POSH, Code of Conduct, IT AUP) — e-signed, mandatory (DO04). Undertaking cluster: uploaded statutory / prior-employment docs plus employer-signature items (NDA, Confidentiality per DO13) — enabled but not mandatory by default (DO02); a tenant may raise it to mandatory via the completion gate. Reference cluster: referee / background inputs — enabled, never mandatory. Only the Sign-Off cluster blocks joining by default.

Performance Admin›Review cycles

Review cycles FR-M09-003

26 cycles in register · 2 active · 24 archived
Review cycle controls — admin Performance Admin / HR AdminFR-M09-030
Admin-only. Available to Performance Admin and HR Admin. L1 Managers cannot open, pause, or resume a review. Open the appraisal review on demand — for one employee, a selected set, a filter-based cohort, or a whole monthly cohort — independent of the period end date. You can pause an in-flight review (freezes stage progression and SLA clocks, preserving entered data) and resume it later. There is no recall once a review is opened.
Review cycles drive the entire appraisal flow. Each cycle owns a date range, user-assignment scope, stages (Self → L1 Evaluator → Calibration → Acknowledgement per FR-M09-003), and links to Goal plans + Calibration sessions. Once a cycle is started, structural changes (stages, frameworks) are locked; cosmetic changes (descriptions, SLAs) remain editable until closure.

Performance Admin›Custom formulas

Custom score formulas FR-M09-019

0 custom formulas · default applies
How goal scores are computed. By default, each goal's score is MIN(achievement_% × weightage × 0.01, 120%). Goals capture their measurement criteria as free text on the goal itself (there is no separate metric catalogue in Phase 1). Use custom formulas only when you need specialised scoring — e.g. step functions, multi-input formulas, or non-linear achievement mapping — attached at the goal-plan level.
Default scoring formula
Formulascore = MIN(achievement_% × weightage × 0.01, 120%)
Over-achievement cap120% (configurable per plan)
Applies toAll goals without an attached custom formula
Achievement inputManual entry (employee → L1 validation)
Custom formulas
No custom formulas configured. The default formula above applies to all goals. If you need step-function scoring (e.g. ≥100% = 5 points · 80–99% = 4 points · 60–79% = 3 points), define a custom formula here and attach it at the goal-plan level during cycle creation.

Performance Admin›Normalization

Normalization curves FR-M09-023

3 curves available
Normalization curves enforce a distribution shape during calibration. When L1 managers rate too generously (or too harshly), the moderator uses the curve to redistribute ratings against the ideal shape. The system flags managers whose ratings deviate by more than 20% from the curve and supports manual override with reason capture.

Document Admin›Document vault

Employee document vault FR-M11-002

12,847 documents · 1,247 employees · 1.2 TB storage
Storage architecture (DM13). S3-equivalent with versioning at bucket level · AES-256 + KMS per-tenant keys · TLS 1.3 · 5-minute pre-signed URL · India home region with DR replica in second Indian region. 10 versions retained hot · cold-tier archive beyond 10 (DM10). Audit-only access to cold-tier versions. Max file size 25 MB · allowed types .pdf .docx .doc .jpg .jpeg .png (DM06/DM07). Virus scan mandatory and cannot be disabled at tenant level (DM08).

External recruiter portal access (FR-M08-006)
Each vendor has a scoped portal where they can submit candidates to assigned requisitions only — no visibility into your full pipeline. Vendor users authenticate via their own credentials; their actions are audit-logged. Contract end dates trigger automatic portal access revocation.

Vendor onboarding FR-M08-006

Step 1 of 4 · Vendor identity
4-step vendor onboarding flow. Identity → Contract terms → Specialisation & scope → Portal access. On submission, a contract draft is generated for Legal review; portal access is provisioned only after the contract is countersigned.
Step 1 · Vendor identity
Mandatory for invoicing and TDS compliance
Step 2 · Contract & commercial terms
% of accepted CTC · industry standard: 8-15% for IC, 20%+ for executive
If hire exits within window, vendor provides free replacement
Step 3 · Specialisation & scope
Number of reqs vendor can work on simultaneously
Step 4 · Portal access
Vendor users will see only their assigned requisitions and submitted candidates
Max 10 users per vendor; additional users billed at ₹500/user/month
Required before portal provisioning · stored in M11 vault

Recruitment Admin›Pre-offer queue

Pre-offer / Intent-to-Hire queue FR-M08-009

4 awaiting issuance · 5 active pre-offers
Pre-offer is non-binding intent (joint authority). Recruitment Admin or HR Admin can issue (recruiters cannot). Communicates an indicative comp band (not the final CTC), starts the document collection clock (default 5 working days), and is gated by the requisition's approved band. Threshold approvals do NOT apply at pre-offer — Finance Admin and CEO sign-off (FR-M08-004) only apply at final offer release after document review.

Variation by population Per Assignment Framework · BU · employee type · grade
Each leave type can be configured differently per population. Example: PL India follows tenure-based slabs 12 → 24 days; PL USA aligned with PTO (15 days flat + accrual); PL UK follows statutory 28 days + bank holidays. Configuration overrides are managed at the entity level (see Legal entities → Per-entity configuration overrides).
Leave-policy assignment assigned via Assignment Framework (assignment_framework_id · §4.2.17)
Each leave policy is targeted to an Assignment Framework rule (employment type, department, project, location, etc.), optionally scoped by Group Company. Entitlement frameworks are configured mutually exclusive by employment type, so each employee resolves to exactly one policy per leave type. Leave is not location-specific. UAG plays no role in leave assignment. Optional Holiday appears here as a leave type too — its per-policy annual quota is the cap, and it links to a Holiday group for the selectable dates.

Org Admin›Entitlement grants

Individual entitlement grants FR-P04

12 active grants · 3 expiring this week
Time-bound exceptions to standard RBAC. Use entitlement grants to give a specific user temporary access beyond their role's default scope (e.g. PII Tier-2 view, leave override, encashment authorisation for a specific audit period). Mandatory expiry date, audit-logged at grant + use + revoke. The principle: grants are exceptions, not workarounds. If a grant is renewed more than twice, the role itself should be revisited.

Platform Admin›Tenants›Provision new tenant

Provision new tenant FR-P04-001

Step 1 of 5 · Identity
Step 1 · Tenant identity
3-8 uppercase chars · used in subdomain (acme.primesoft.io)
Step 2 · Segment & geography
Drives data residency region selection
Step 3 · Deployment model
STANDALONE
Single organisation · single legal entity. Simplest model. Best for < 1,000 employees in one country.
GROUP_COMPANY ✓
One tenant · multiple legal entities. Shared master data. Independent statutory configs per entity. Cross-entity visibility via Org Admin.
MULTI_TENANT_SAAS
Shared infrastructure with strict tenant isolation. PrimeSoft hosts all data. Used for SaaS reseller scenarios.
Step 4 · Plan & licensing
Step 5 · Initial Org Admin user
Provisioning timeline. Tenant infrastructure spins up in ~3 minutes. The Org Admin receives a setup link via email with 24-hour validity. The first 7 days are setup-only (no user onboarding) — Org Admin configures entities, branding, SSO, integrations before activating Wave-1 migration or live operations.
All 5 steps required. Review before provisioning. Tenant ID, deployment model, and data region cannot be changed after provisioning.
Platform Admin›P06 Migration Toolkit

P06 Migration Toolkit FR-P06

3 migrations in flight
ETL+V framework (Extract · Validate · Transform · Load · Verify). Three-wave plan per BRD §10. Strict gating between dry runs and production cutover — failure threshold < 0.5% for Wave 1 + Wave 2; zero numeric discrepancies for payroll amounts in Wave 3. Each migrated record carries darwinbox_source_id for traceability.
